note: Recorded Security Chief turns for Halvorsen Tower, matched by src/agents/chief/recorded.ts on the alarm transition. The first turn whose `when` matches answers; a transition with none gets the deterministic template (template.ts). Zone ids are the ones the Run screen sends for the F1 fixture floor: the cached manifest's zones and entries (data/levels/F1.romaine-1974.json; these replies are kept per building, so any mission on F1 reuses them), and the floor's other rooms by id. Written for beat 5: the judge walks straight into C2's half of the dock corridor on turn 1.
